work_unit: Diagnose post-login authentication-required response in the local runtime

dispatch.scope: Read-only audit of login token handoff and authorization validation
dispatch.outcome: Interrupted after the coordinator obtained sufficient live runtime evidence; no worker changes were made.

finding.runtime: During diagnosis, host development processes and a restarting Docker Desktop engine alternately owned the application ports. That allowed the browser to retain a token issued by an earlier process while subsequent protected requests reached a different runtime.
finding.resolution: The full Docker stack was rebuilt and started. The running frontend and backend now both report hybrid mode, and both health endpoints return HTTP 200.

verification.containers: Frontend and backend are healthy in the same Compose project.
verification.mode_parity: BACKEND_AUTH_MODE=hybrid and NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_MODE=hybrid were verified from the running containers.
verification.limitation: No real account credentials or user document were used in the live diagnosis. A fresh browser login is required to validate a new account token against the unified runtime.
